description: This file defines the TableArg class and related functions for handling table arguments in Spark SQL connect, including partitioning and ordering of subquery expressions.

classes.name: TableArg
classes.description: A class representing table arguments with methods for partitioning and ordering in Spark SQL connect.

methods.name: _to_cols
methods.description: Converts a tuple of column names or ColumnOrName sequences into a list of Column objects.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Adds partitioning columns to the table argument, raising an exception if already partitioned.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Adds ordering columns to the table argument, requiring prior partitioning.

methods.name: withSinglePartition
methods.description: Sets the table argument to use a single partition, raising an exception if already partitioned.

methods.name: to_plan
methods.description: Converts the table argument's subquery expression to a protocol buffer expression for execution.
